## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Scientific contract

State whether domain, indexing, space, topology, metric, support,
measurement semantics, transforms, provenance, or numerical definitions
change. If none change, say so explicitly.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant unit tests pass.
- [ ] New behavior has adversarial or reference tests.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the public API.
- [ ] No external neuroimaging binary became a runtime dependency.
- [ ] Resource-bounded behavior is preserved.
